title: Teraflock model catalog manifest
description: One manifest per model in catalog/<id>.yaml. Fields align with flock.types.v1.ModelSpec (proto repo) plus catalog-only metadata per SPEC §4.6 and §7. Per-quant sha256/size_bytes come from the upstream artifact host and are verified by flockd before serving; tok/s envelopes are honest rough estimates used by the trust engine's timing sanity checks, not benchmarks.

id.description: Catalog model id, e.g. llama-3.1-8b-instruct. Must equal the manifest filename (without .yaml). ModelSpec.id is derived as <id>-<quant-lowercased>.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown on customer surfaces (website, console, playground pickers), e.g. "Qwen3 8B" or "Qwen3.8 27B". IDs alone are ambiguous now that model lines carry point versions — qwen3-8b (Qwen3, 8B) vs qwen3.8-27b (Qwen3.8, 27B).

params_b.description: TOTAL parameter count in billions. Payout class (and price) key on this.

active_params_b.description: Parameters active per token, for Mixture-of-Experts models; omit for dense. The trust engine's timing envelopes key on this — an MoE decodes at active-param speed, and judging it by total params reads an honest node as impossibly fast (control-plane trust.TimingClass). REQUIRED for MoE: the validator rejects a manifest whose architecture is moe, or whose id/source_repo carries the -a<N>b MoE suffix, without it.

architecture.description: Dense or Mixture-of-Experts. Set it on every new manifest. moe requires active_params_b; dense forbids it. Optional only so existing manifests need not change; the -a<N>b naming heuristic covers those, and this field is what catches MoE releases without the suffix (gpt-oss).

notes.description: Caveats, e.g. Llama Community License commercial-serving terms (SPEC §13.2).

payout_class.description: Pricing class per SPEC §7. Embedding models carry a class for hardware-tiering purposes but are priced separately (embeddings: true overrides the class price table).

context_length.description: Maximum context window in tokens as served (may be lower than the architecture max).

embeddings.description: True if served via /v1/embeddings instead of chat/completions.

fingerprint_set_id.description: Id of a challenge prompt set in fingerprints/prompts/<set-id>.yaml. Expected outputs live in the private control-plane repo, keyed by (model_sha, quant, runtime_build_id).

price_in_per_mtok.description: Interactive customer price in USD per million input (prompt) tokens; batch is 0.5×. Fixed per payout_class by SPEC §7 — copy, never set.

price_out_per_mtok.description: Interactive customer price in USD per million output (completion) tokens; batch is 0.5×. Fixed per payout_class by SPEC §7.

payout_share.description: Share of the customer charge (input and output) paid to the serving node before multipliers; rises with hardware scarcity per SPEC §7 (0.40 nano → 0.75 xl).

source_repo.description: Upstream artifact repository the quant files are pulled from (HF-proxied by the registry CDN in production).

quant.description: One servable quantization. Exactly one of (artifact_url + sha256) for a single-file GGUF or parts for a sharded one (oneOf below). size_bytes is always the total download size: the single file, or the sum of parts (never including mmproj).
llama.cpp quantization name, canonical upper-case form.

artifact_url.description: Direct download URL of a single-file GGUF artifact. Sharded releases (-NNNNN-of-NNNNN.gguf) use parts instead; listing shard 1 here is rejected by the validator.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the single-file artifact. flockd refuses to serve on mismatch (SPEC §6). 'TODO-verify' is permitted only while a manifest is in draft; CI policy may reject it on release branches. Absent for multi-part quants: their composite id (sha256 over the concatenated part hashes, see the proto design note 2026-09-08-sharded-artifacts) is derived by the emitter and the registry, never hand-written.

size_bytes.description: Total download size in bytes: the single file, or the sum of parts (the validator enforces equality). mmproj is not included.

parts.description: Sharded GGUF, one entry per shard in llama.cpp series order: basenames <name>-00001-of-0000N.gguf .. <name>-0000N-of-0000N.gguf, same directory, exactly N entries. Every part is pinned like a single-file artifact; flockd stores them as sibling files under their upstream basenames so llama.cpp discovers the series from part 1.

mmproj.description: Optional vision projector sidecar (mmproj-*.gguf) for vision-language releases, passed to llama-server --mmproj. Projectors are per-precision upstream (mmproj-F16.gguf, mmproj-BF16.gguf), hence per quant. Same pinning rules as a part; not counted in size_bytes.

min_vram_mb.description: Minimum dedicated VRAM (or unified memory budget) to load the artifact plus a working KV cache.

min_ram_mb.description: Minimum system RAM for CPU/unified-memory serving.

tok_s_estimates.description: ESTIMATED single-stream decode tokens/sec envelopes per hardware class (embedding models: batched embedding tokens/sec). Used for timing sanity checks (SPEC §2.2). Omit a class if the quant cannot reasonably run on it.

part.description: One pinned file of a multi-file artifact. Field names match flock.types.v1.ArtifactPart.

url.description: Direct download URL; the basename is what flockd writes to disk.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of this file (HF tree API: lfs.oid). 'TODO-verify' only while in draft.
